description: The bar chart titled “Evaluation Based on Different Tasks” illustrates accuracy results for three methods across two evaluation tasks. The horizontal axis contains the task categories “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval,” arranged left to right, while the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and uses a linear scale from 0.0 up to about 0.7 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.2 intervals (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6). For “MCQ Eval,” there are three adjacent bars: an orange “Base” bar reaching 0.644 (value printed above), a pale yellow-green “RMU with Enhanced GCG” bar reaching 0.539, and a light yellow “RMU” bar reaching 0.299. For “Generation Eval,” the same three-color grouping appears: the orange “Base” bar reaches 0.597, the pale yellow-green “RMU with Enhanced GCG” bar reaches 0.263, and the light yellow “RMU” bar reaches 0.106. The bars are grouped by task with consistent left-to-right ordering within each group matching the legend (Base, RMU with Enhanced GCG, RMU), each bar has a black outline and a numeric annotation above it, and there is no indication that bars are sorted beyond the fixed grouping by task.
